title_zh: 最高法发布审理道路交通事故损害赔偿案件司法解释（二）
title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Judicial Interpretation (II) on Trial of Road Traffic Accident Damage Compensation Cases
summary_zh: 最高人民法院发布审理道路交通事故损害赔偿案件司法解释（二），旨在通过明确裁判责任来指引交通安全，共筑平安道路。
summary_en: The Supreme People's Court released Judicial Interpretation (II) on the trial of road traffic accident damage compensation cases to clarify liability and enhance road safety.
